description: Change log rotation for the given log types (PATCH /mysql/v1/clusters/{clusterName}/log-config, merge-patch; the only synchronous write — returns 200 with the new settings).

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-30 chars, lowercase letters/digits/'-', no leading or trailing '-'; immutable after creation)

megaBytes.description: Rotate at N MB (SIZE only; 10-100, multiple of 10)

rotations.description: logType → rotation settings (only the given types change)

name: ncloud_serverless_update_log_config
